open_obligations: Check that Bowman et al.'s sandwiching compares non-expert performance with expert performance in a way comparable to Michael et al.'s judge accuracy
Note that Michael et al.'s 'experts' are human debaters with passage access, not a capable but misaligned model

Note the role difference: in Bowman et al., non-expert participants try to train or align the model and the experts take part only at the end of each experimental cycle to evaluate; in Michael et al., judges are assessed on whether they can perform close to expert level on the basis of the debate, and the experts are the human debaters.
out.other_title: Sandwiching experimental design (Cotra 2021): non-experts align a model, experts evaluate
out.rationale: The passage names Bowman et al.'s implementation of sandwiching and states the change (human debaters as the experts), so EXTENDS fits.
out.scope: proposed EXTENDS: Sandwiching-style evaluation of scalable oversight; this variant uses expert human debaters in place of an AI model
